builtBy: research on 2026-10-03: club directories (NCFHA, BAFHA), the clubs' own sites, SportsRecruits athlete and organization pages, NCSA, Hudl, MaxPreps career club teams, Stick Together, the Gilroy Dispatch and other local news; every affiliation checked by a checker that re-opened each source and then by an independent refuter
notes: Which club field hockey teams the players on the 43 tracked varsity rosters play (or played) for, joined to data/rosters.json on team slug + MaxPreps athleteId. Only players on those rosters are named (varsity rows; rows the overlay marks JV are out of scope). A club's own roster lists many more players, who are not named here: the club's roster pages are linked instead.

The linking rule is the one data/rosters-enrichment.json uses for recruiting profiles, applied to clubs: a public page must name the player and a field hockey club, and either name the player's high school, or give a class year that agrees with the roster grade together with a Northern California location (the player's hometown, or a club or team based in Northern California). A class year that disagrees with the roster grade rules a match out; a name alone never makes one. Lacrosse, soccer and ice hockey clubs do not count, and neither do social-media posts.

Every affiliation was checked twice on 2026-10-03: a checker re-opened each source and applied the rule, then an independent refuter re-opened the sources and tried to break it (another person of the same name, a quote not on the page, a misidentified club, a class year that disagrees, a stale listing). Only affiliations that survived both are here. Each source keeps its URL, kind and a verbatim quote; basis says what the match rests on.

status: current = the source reflects the 2025-26 or 2026-27 club seasons (dated August 2025 or later, a club's current-players page, or a live recruiting profile that lists the club); past = dated earlier, an alumni list, or a club the player's own page lists for earlier years; unknown = listed with no usable date. asOf is the date or season the source gives. confidence: high = one first-hand page names player, club and school (or is the player's own profile); medium = the match rests on a club roster's class-year heading plus the club's location, on a team nickname standing for the school, or on a single self-reported line.

clubs[] are the youth field hockey clubs around the 43 schools (San Francisco, the Peninsula, the South Bay, the East Bay, Marin and the Central Coast) plus any club a rostered player is tied to. Each record was read from the club's own site on 2026-10-03 and names no individual. Clubs that run only adult teams or only K-5 clinics are left out unless a rostered player is tied to them.

Recall is partial. Sources searched: the NCFHA and BAFHA club directories, every club's own site, SportsRecruits athlete and organization pages, NCSA, Hudl, the club-teams block on each rostered player's MaxPreps career page (all 716 varsity rows), Stick Together (sticktogetherfh.com), the Gilroy Dispatch and other local and school news, USA Field Hockey and MAX Field Hockey event lists. A player with no public page that meets the rule is not listed, whatever club they play for. See docs/DATA-SOURCES.md.
